record.paper_title: Some New Results of Two Open Problems Related to Integral Inequalities
record.context_brief: Exponent refinement of a convex integral ratio inequality
record.original_question: Let [a,b] be a real interval. Let f, g, and h be positive continuous real-valued functions on [a,b] such that f(x)≤h(x) for every x in [a,b], the quotient f(x)/h(x) is decreasing, and f and g are increasing. Let ϕ be a convex function with ϕ(0)=0. Determine conditions on δ and λ under which the integral ratio inequality (∫_a^b f(x) dx)/(∫_a^b h(x) dx) ≥ (∫_a^b ϕ(f(x))g(x) dx)^δ/(∫_a^b ϕ(h(x))g(x) dx)^λ holds.

evidence.quote: Abstract. In this paper, we have solved two open problems, and as consequence some interesting integral inequalities are obtained.

Let f(x),g(x),h(x) > 0 be continuous functions on [a,b] with f(x) ≤ h(x) for all x and such that f(x)/h(x) is decreasing and f(x),g(x) are increasing. Assume that ϕ(x) is a convex function with ϕ(0)=0.

Open Problem 2. Assume that ϕ(x) is a convex function with ϕ(0)=0. Under what conditions does the inequality (∫_a^b f(x)dx)/(∫_a^b h(x)dx) ≥ (∫_a^b ϕ(f(x))g(x)dx)^δ/(∫_a^b ϕ(h(x))g(x)dx)^λ hold for δ and λ ?

artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem (refining an inequality previously studied by Ngô–Thang–Dat–Tuan and Liu–Ngô) and has been addressed in subsequent literature giving sufficient conditions on δ and λ (e.g., relating δ and λ through the ranges of f and h). The referenced work explicitly claims to solve this open problem.
